title: How many politicians will leave their cabinet positions in the UK government before 2027?
resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve as the total number of Members of Parliament acting as one of the top 18 ranked cabinet members (as of July 20, 2026) who leave their positions after September 1, 2026 and before January 1, 2027. Any reason for leaving cabinet positions will count. If three or more cabinet members leave their positions, this question will resolve to **3 or more**.

If the Prime Minister changes during this period the question will resolve to the number as of that date.

[His Majesty's Government: The Cabinet](https://members.parliament.uk/government/cabinet) webpage will be used for resolution.

background:
On July 17, 2026, Andy Burnham became the [Leader of the UK Labour Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leader_of_the_Labour_Party_\(UK\) "Leader of the Labour Party (UK)"), and he assumed the role of [Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_the_United_Kingdom "Prime Minister of the United Kingdom") three days later. In doing so he became the sixth person in the last ten years to govern the UK, [the seventh Prime Minister since 2016](https://www.gov.uk/government/speeches/andy-burnhams-first-speech-as-prime-minister-20-july-2026).

As a result [many of the cabinet positions changed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burnham_ministry) hands, though some in Burnham's cabinet also held positions [in Starmer's previous cabinet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starmer_ministry). The following cabinet members retained their positions:

* Home Secretary
* Secretary of State for Work and Pensions
* Secretary of State for Transport
* Secretary of State for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport
* Secretary of State for Scotland
